grammar.pattern: V + 得 / 不 + 结果；V + 得 / 不 + 了
grammar.purpose: Describe potential completion rather than permission
grammar.explanation: 看得懂/看不懂 describes whether understanding is possible. 拿得动/拿不动 describes ability to move an item. 今天处理得了这些邮件吗 asks whether completion is manageable; 了 is liǎo in this potential complement. 不可以 is a permission judgment, different from 看不懂. A capability statement does not establish actual completion.

examples.py: zhè fēng yóu jiàn wǒ kàn dé dǒng .

examples.zh: 这些邮件今天处理不了。
examples.py: zhè xiē yóu jiàn jīn tiān chǔ lǐ bù le .
examples.en: These emails cannot be dealt with today.

examples.py: tā ná bù dòng zhè gè xiāng zi .
examples.en: She cannot lift or move this box.

commonMistakes.wrong: 看得懂就是已经看完了。
commonMistakes.right: 看得懂表示能够理解，不代表已经看完。
commonMistakes.why: Potential completion and actual completion differ.

grammar.pattern: V + 次数 + 名物 / V + 代词 + 次数
grammar.purpose: Place the object with an event count
grammar.explanation: 我看了两遍报告 puts the noun object after the count. 我问了她三次 puts a pronoun object before the count. With people’s names, different placements are possible according to context; do not invent an absolute placement rule for all nouns. Keep the counted event distinct from the number of objects: 看两遍报告 is two readings, not necessarily two reports.

examples.py: wǒ kàn le liǎng biàn bào gào .
wǒ gěi tā dǎ le liǎng cì diàn huà .
wǒ wèn le tā sān cì .

commonMistakes.why: For this ordinary pronoun-object count, put 她 before 三次.

lines.zh: 这段场景讲海关还是旅行社？我看不懂标题。
lines.py: zhè duàn chǎng jǐng jiǎng hǎi guān hái shi lǚ xíng shè ? wǒ kàn bù dǒng biāo tí .
lines.en: Is the scene about customs or a travel agency? I cannot understand the title.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 旅行社发出电子邮件，介绍一个虚构的大使馆访问。
lines.py: lǚ xíng shè fā chū diàn zǐ yóu jiàn , jiè shào yī gè xū gòu de dà shǐ guǎn fǎng wèn .
lines.en: The travel agency sends an email introducing a fictional embassy visit.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我看了两遍报告，邮件里的资金写美元。
lines.py: wǒ kàn le liǎng biàn bào gào , yóu jiàn lǐ de zī jīn xiě měi yuán .
lines.en: I read the report twice; the funds in the email are in US dollars.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对，不是人民币。这段交易不是实际付款。
lines.py: duì , bù shì rén mín bì . zhè duàn jiāo yì bù shì shí jì fù kuǎn .
lines.en: Right, not renminbi; this transaction is not a real payment.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 身份证和证件能直接发表在报上吗？
lines.py: shēn fèn zhèng hé zhèng jiàn néng zhí jiē fā biǎo zài bào shàng ma ?
lines.en: May ID cards and document details be published directly in the newspaper?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不能替别人同意。正式通知也要查来源。
lines.py: bù néng tì bié ren tóng yì . zhèng shì tōng zhī yě yào chá lái yuán .
lines.en: Do not consent for others; check the source of formal notices too.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 她问了工作人员三次，还没收到回答。
lines.py: tā wèn le gōng zuò rén yuán sān cì , hái méi shōu dào huí dá .
lines.en: She asked the staff member three times and has not received a reply.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 所以别把通信记录当成确认；看得懂也不等于已经办完。
lines.py: suǒ yǐ bié bǎ tōng xìn jì lù dàng chéng què rèn ; kàn dé dǒng yě bù děng yú yǐ jīng bàn wán .
lines.en: So do not treat correspondence as confirmation; understanding does not mean having completed the procedure.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 报上的报道与内部报告不同，充满疑问时要核对来源和日期。
lines.py: bào shàng de bào dào yǔ nèi bù bào gào bù tóng , chōng mǎn yí wèn shí yào hé duì lái yuán hé rì qī .

lines.zh: 信封写收件人，邮票只是邮资标记，不是身份确认。
lines.py: xìn fēng xiě shōu jiàn rén , yóu piào zhǐ shì yóu zī biāo jì , bù shì shēn fèn què rèn .
lines.en: The envelope states the recipient; the stamp marks postage rather than confirms identity.

lines.zh: 证件和身份证由本人保管，出示工作证也不能随便公开个人信息。
lines.py: zhèng jiàn hé shēn fèn zhèng yóu běn rén bǎo guǎn , chū shì gōng zuò zhèng yě bù néng suí biàn gōng kāi gè rén xìn xī .
lines.en: Keep ID documents personally; showing work ID does not allow casual publication of personal information.

lines.zh: 海关与大使馆的场景是虚构练习，不提供真实办事规则；信要有依据。
lines.py: hǎi guān yǔ dà shǐ guǎn de chǎng jǐng shì xū gòu liàn xí , bù tí gōng zhēn shí bàn shì guī zé ; xìn yào yǒu yī jù .
lines.en: The customs and embassy scenario is fictional practice and provides no actual procedural rules; belief requires evidence.

lines.zh: 交易没有付款，资金记录注明美元，负责的人要核对对象与条件。
lines.py: jiāo yì méi yǒu fù kuǎn , zī jīn jì lù zhù míng měi yuán , fù zé de rén yào hé duì duì xiàng yǔ tiáo jiàn .
lines.en: No payment occurs in the transaction; funds records specify dollars, and the responsible person checks parties and terms.

lines.zh: 我看了两遍报告，数的是阅读次数；我问了她三次，代词在次数前。
lines.py: wǒ kàn le liǎng biàn bào gào , shù de shì yuè dú cì shù ; wǒ wèn le tā sān cì , dài cí zài cì shù qián .
lines.en: I read the report twice, counting readings; I asked her three times, putting the pronoun before the count.

lines.zh: 今天处理不了所有邮件，是能力与时间的限制；看得懂也不代表办完。
lines.py: jīn tiān chǔ lǐ bù le suǒ yǒu yóu jiàn , shì néng lì yǔ shí jiān de xiàn zhì ; kàn dé dǒng yě bù dài biǎo bàn wán .
lines.en: Inability to process all emails today concerns capacity and time; understanding does not imply completion.
